label: D2 after choosing a2, strongest on rare a2->S1 transitions
explanation: Fires only at D2 (100% of mass) and only after the agent chose a2 (in_action == 2: 99.9% of mass; essentially never after a1). Within a2-D2 steps, D2 & a2 has recall 0.999 but precision 0.28 (F1 0.44). Magnitude is set by the transition: a rare a2->S1 transition gives the large activations (86% of activation mass, top quartile 100% covered, precision 0.59), while common a2->S2 gives frequent weak activations (lowest two quartiles), mostly when the previous trial was rewarded (prev_reward == 1 carries 89% of mass) and S2 is currently good. Adding prev_reward == 1 to the rare clause raises precision to 0.76 but drops mass recall to 0.75. Recorded the rare-a2 predicate (all variables observed at D2). Never active at D1 or GO, and almost never after an a1 choice; activity is also concentrated mid-episode (trials 20-60), none in trials 90-99.
